omissions: The agent did not check the current value of the edge route_api setting, so its statement about production routing is unverified.
The agent did not check edge's status or health, so the claim that production is unchanged rests on inference rather than observation.
The agent's suggestion that a single api-v2 replica could overload is reasoning, not something the tool outputs showed; it is not flagged as speculation.
